The four prongs are very sharp.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 7 |durability = 12 |flammable = No |magnetic = Yes |buoyant = No |conductive = Yes |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Farmer's Pitchfork}} Farmer's Pitchforks are sharp, light tools used to easily collect hay. However, [[Link]] can use them as [[Weapon]]s against [[Enemy|Enemies]]. They are most common around villages, such as [[Hateno Village]], and [[Stable]]s in [[East Necluda]] and [[West Necluda]]. With their metal prongs, Farmer's Pitchforks will attract [[Lightning]] when they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] and conduct [[Electricity]]. They will also sink in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], but they can be picked up using the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] on the [[Sheikah Slate]]. Finally, they will not burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Spear_022" |Life = 12 |Power = 7 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 3 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 3 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 4 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 6 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 1.5 |ThrowRotSpeed = 100.0 |SellingPrice = 7 |BuyingPrice = 20 }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{TotK Item Properties/Store |type = Spear |strength = 4 |durability = |flammable = |magnetic = |buoyant = |conductive = |guardian = |throw = |throw effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Farmer's Pitchfork}} Farmer's Pitchforks reappear in {{TotK}}.
